entities.name: Toshiaki Tsushima
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Toshiaki Tsushima  was a Japanese composer, mainly known for his film scores. Born in Okayama Prefecture, he graduated from the Arts Department of Nihon University in Tokyo. He died on November 25, 2013, of pneumonia.
